name: SF Unlock Blueprints
description: Unlocks crafting recipes through the native keen::RecipeRegistryResource type.

changelog: Added a declarative overview page for the Modloader UI.

components.label: Startup transformation
components.text: When enabled, the loader edits recipe registry resources during early game startup.
Supported recipes receive the configured always-available knowledge requirement for the current session.

components.label: Restart required
components.text: The asset change takes effect on the next game start.
